# camunda_cluster_backup (Resource)

Take a backup of a cluster on Camunda SaaS. Creating the resource starts a backup and waits until it is complete; a failed backup fails the creation. Backups can't be changed, so a change to `cluster_id` creates a new backup, and destroying the resource deletes the backup. Only available if the cluster's plan supports backups.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "camunda_cluster_backup" "test" {
  cluster_id = camunda_cluster.test.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID

### Read-Only

- `backup_id` (String) The ID of the backup, to use when restoring it.
- `completed` (String) When the backup finished.
- `created` (String) When the backup was started.
- `generation_id` (String) ID of the generation the cluster ran when the backup was taken. Null for legacy backups.
- `generation_name` (String) Name of that generation. Null for legacy backups.
- `id` (String) Backup ID, in the form `<cluster_id>/<backup_id>`
- `name` (String) The name of the backup.
- `operate_status` (String) Status of the Operate part of the backup. One of `In progress`, `Failed`, `Complete` or `-`.
- `optimize_status` (String) Status of the Optimize part of the backup. One of `In progress`, `Failed`, `Complete` or `-`.
- `status` (String) Overall status of the backup. One of `In progress`, `Failed`, `Complete` or `-`.
- `tasklist_status` (String) Status of the Tasklist part of the backup. One of `In progress`, `Failed`, `Complete` or `-`.
- `zeebe_status` (String) Status of the Zeebe part of the backup. One of `In progress`, `Failed`, `Complete` or `-`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Backups are imported by "<cluster_id>/<backup_id>".
terraform import camunda_cluster_backup.test '<cluster_id>/<backup_id>'
```
